macro_themes.title: US Inflation and Fed Policy Uncertainty
macro_themes.summary: US CPI data released last week came in hotter than expected, reinforcing concerns about sticky inflation. This has led markets to price out Fed rate cuts for 2026 and even entertain the possibility of a hike. The Fed's upcoming FOMC meeting is now a key focus, with market expectations for a hawkish hold or even a hike increasing. This uncertainty is driving significant USD strength across the board.

macro_themes.title: Geopolitical Tensions Escalate
macro_themes.summary: Renewed geopolitical tensions in Eastern Europe are increasing risk aversion globally. This is leading to a flight to safety, benefiting traditional safe-haven currencies like the USD and JPY, while weighing on riskier assets and currencies. The situation remains fluid and is a key driver of the current risk-off sentiment.

macro_themes.title: ECB Policy Divergence from Fed
macro_themes.summary: While the Fed is facing upward inflation pressure, the ECB is signaling a more dovish stance, with expectations of rate cuts later in the year. This policy divergence is creating significant headwinds for the EUR, particularly against a strengthening USD. Upcoming ECB commentary will be closely watched.

macro_themes.title: BoJ Intervention Risk Looms
macro_themes.summary: The continued weakness in the JPY, driven by the widening interest rate differential with the US and risk-off sentiment, is increasing the likelihood of direct intervention by the Bank of Japan. While no intervention has occurred yet, the threat remains a key factor for USD/JPY and other Yen crosses.

macro_themes.title: Commodity Price Volatility
macro_themes.summary: Recent volatility in oil and gold prices, driven by geopolitical events and inflation expectations, is adding to market uncertainty. While not the primary driver, commodity price swings can influence risk sentiment and impact commodity-linked currencies like AUD and CAD.

core_pairs.catalyst: Fed/BoJ policy divergence, JPY weakness, intervention risk
core_pairs.summary: USD/JPY remains in a strong uptrend, driven by widening interest rate differentials and risk-off sentiment. Intervention risk is a key overhang, but the pair is pushing higher on the back of USD strength.

core_pairs.catalyst: US inflation, Fed hawkishness, ECB dovishness
core_pairs.summary: EUR/USD is under pressure due to strong USD demand stemming from US inflation data and hawkish Fed expectations. Divergence with the ECB's more dovish stance further weighs on the pair.

core_pairs.catalyst: USD strength, UK inflation data pending
core_pairs.summary: GBP/USD is declining as the strong USD dominates. Upcoming UK inflation data will be crucial for Bank of England policy expectations and could provide some support or further downside.

core_pairs.catalyst: Risk-off sentiment, USD strength, commodity prices
core_pairs.summary: AUD/USD is falling amid a broad risk-off move and strong USD. While commodity prices are a factor, the dominant theme is USD strength and risk aversion.
USD/CAD is supported by broad USD strength and some volatility in oil prices. The pair is likely to follow the USD's direction, with oil prices providing secondary influence.
